question: Which customers ordered laptops that are stocked in the Berlin warehouse?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE cat.category_name = 'Laptops' AND w.warehouse_name = 'Berlin Distribution Center';

SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
